title: Combine two texts
summary: Join two texts with a blank line between them.

sections.use: Join the outputs of two steps into one text, separated by a blank line, for example two sections into one report.
sections.exclusions: Exactly two parts and no headings; edit the block for more parts, a separator or headings.
sections.missing_data: An empty part is joined as it is, so the result starts or ends with the blank line.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.
